items.title: A clearer week and calmer focus
items.body: Week is now a date-led agenda with time-stamped blocks, and Day, Week, and Pending each have their own scope. Focus evidence reads as game-style chips, unread notes stay on top, Auto-arrange only counts real moves, and partial focus sessions now appear in History → Partial. You'll see this update once when you open the app.

items.title: Welcome to DeeCadence
items.body: Start with one small focus block, let the timer carry you, and watch your Rank grow as you show up. The ? on Today and the help library in Settings are always there if you need a hand.

items.title: A calmer, safer Plan
items.body: Missed, Ready, and Done now collapse out of the way, and deleting a task clears matching copies plus their recurrence branches.

items.title: Progress at a glance
items.body: Cadence and Momentum now sit together, the chart stays close to your focus history, and your strongest day is marked in the selected range.

items.title: Join the DeeCadence WhatsApp group
items.body: Release notes, focus challenges, and early invitations land there first. It is optional, quiet, and you can leave whenever you like.

items.title: Try an adaptive focus rhythm
items.body: After a few completed blocks, DeeCadence can shape an unequal rhythm around your history: an easier first start, then longer focus blocks with recovery between them. Try Adaptive in session setup, then tell us whether it feels better.

items.title: A nudge at the right moment
items.body: DeeCadence now reminds you when a focus block ends so you can start the next one, and gives calendar-style reminders for tasks with a time in your plan. Permission is asked after your first block, never on launch. Set the lead time in Settings → Notifications.

items.title: Keep DeeCadence close
items.body: You can add DeeCadence to your home screen for quicker access. On Android and desktop, look for the install banner; on iPhone, tap Share → Add to Home Screen. It is also in Settings.

items.title: A calmer interface, by default
items.body: Motion, glow and shimmer now start off for a quieter focus. If you miss the pulsing orbs, switch them back on in Settings. The first screen and the Today rank ring were also tidied up on small screens.
